name: Native answer corrections, recall and thread isolation
covers: model applies a correction over earlier turns
model keeps another thread out of its answer

steps.prompt: Use no tools. Remember this fictional booking: reference CF-731, timeout 20 minutes. State exactly CF-731: 20 minutes.
Correction: the timeout is now 45 minutes. State the booking reference from our conversation and the current timeout only. Use no tools.
Without tools, repeat only the booking reference and latest timeout we agreed on.

isolation.prompt: Without tools, has a booking reference been provided in THIS thread? If none was supplied, reply exactly NO_BOOKING_CONTEXT. Do not guess.
